Saves one coherent health history snapshot for a restart; its fault only cancels the restart attempt, never a request or a start
Reopens the health floor gate after a cancelled restart and replays the skipped save and sample; decides nothing about access
Reopens the health floor gate when a stop signal wins, so periodic saves run until the stop; decides nothing about access
Makes the health floor gate final at the restart commit edge; periodic saves and samples then skip; refuses no request
